title.vi: Thông báo Công ty (Tỷ lệ Phần trăm theo Quy định tại Điều 76B(3) và (3B)) 2013

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Companies (Prescribed Percentage under Section 76B(3) and (3B)) Notification 2013 and shall come into operation on 1st October 2013.

heading.en: Prescribed percentage under section 76B(3) and (3B) of Act

text.en: 2. For the purposes of section 76B(3) and (3B) of the Act, the prescribed percentage shall be 20%.
